meta.match_contract: e1_real_audit.match_gt greedy nearest-centroid, robot-path accepted_false, shared used-set per frame, file order

rule_headline: HEADLINE (calibrated, conservative): note held->in_hand; note occluded/behind/split-by-wrist/gripper->occluded; note bin(incl rim)->in_bin; else centroid in CURRENT-POSE FK hand mask->in_hand; else centroid in CURRENT-POSE FK arm/base mask->occluded; else visible_on_mat. Neutral-pose-only FK hits are artifacts (arm not there in this frame) and do NOT exclude. No geometry: unsure rows stay visible, so the headline is a LOWER bound, robust to the counter_z placeholder.
rule_literal_fk: VARIANT literal-2D-FK (uncalibrated prescription): same note rules, then the PUBLIC combined FK mask (current pose OR full neutral-pose body): current-pose hand capsules->in_hand, any other mask pixel->occluded. Includes the neutral-pose arm artifact.
rule_geom_variant: VARIANT geom (approximate): literal-2D-FK plus ray-plane xy inside a bin footprint (GateGeometry, counter_z=0.01 nominal = sim placeholder) -> in_bin, unless the note says 'on mat'. Over-excludes at the placeholder height; approximate upper end, not the headline.

neutral_artifact_examples.note: shadow face partly merged into orange mask

fk_calibration.finding: FKMask.frame_mask ORs in the full neutral-pose body (base_mask). 71 GT centroids (68 without decisive notes) land on neutral-pose ARM pixels where the arm is not in the current frame; 31 of them were detected. Crops confirm visible objects (e.g. e06a O3). The headline keeps them visible; the literal-2D-FK variant shows the uncalibrated prescription.
fk_calibration.depth_ordering_probe: A ray-capsule depth-ordering probe (scratch) was inconclusive: the sign of (object depth - robot depth) flips with the unknown table height (26/39 rows flip between counter_z 0.01 and 0.15), so depth ordering is NOT used. Current-pose 2D FK exclusion is kept per the audit rule; crops show a few of those objects sit in front of the hand (e09a/e02a/e14c) - bounded by the notes-only sensitivity below.

geom_variant_evidence.explanation: At tag a (20% of each episode) no object has been placed yet, so tag-a objects cannot be in a bin; e00a O0/O1 (purple cube, orange prism) are documented in AUDIT.md F3 as real mat objects in front of the bins. The nominal counter_z=0.01 plane is too low (real table +5-14 cm higher, review F1/R9), so centroid rays overshoot into the bin footprints. The geom variant therefore over-excludes visible mat objects and inflates recall; the headline drops geometry entirely (conservative lower bound).

ambiguity.definition: ambiguity_rate_no_locus_info = fraction of GT rows whose note carries no locus information (empty, shape-check, merged-split, mask-missed, edge notes); these are decided by current-pose FK or kept visible by the conservative default. Ambiguous rows are NEVER excluded on geometry in the headline, and neutral-pose FK artifacts never exclude.

fk_mask.method: FKMask public frame_mask (pinocchio FK from parquet joint state, simplified link capsules + static neutral-pose body) projected into cam_high; partitioned into current-pose hand, current-pose arm+base, neutral-pose arms; sanity hand|arm|neutral == public combined; fallback ok_nosplit -> any FK hit counts as occluded

notes_only_no_fk.note: drops ALL FK exclusions (current-pose too); upper-bounds the effect of FK mask approximation on the headline

sensitivity.note2: known FPs from label_verify.json (independent visual audit); primary numbers keep them (measurement only). Dropping them is a sensitivity, not the headline.

caveats: counter_z=0.01 m is the SIM PLACEHOLDER (review F1), not a measured table height. The geom variant's in_bin stratification is approximate and demonstrably over-excludes at this height (see geom_variant_evidence). A corrected counter_z re-run is pending (another agent); use --counter-z/--suffix then. The HEADLINE (notes+current-pose FK) is robust to this: it uses no geometry.

Headline fair recall is a LOWER bound: unsure rows stay visible, including silent-note objects that may already be inside bins, and neutral-pose FK artifacts. The geom variant is the approximate upper end; the corrected counter_z will tighten the interval.

FK masks are simplified link capsules from the recorded joint state projected with the CALIBRATION camera pose; frames whose real pose differs shift the mask. The public combined mask includes the static neutral-pose body; 64 GT centroids land on neutral-pose ARM pixels (arm not there in-frame); the 61 without decisive notes are kept visible in the headline. Current-pose 2D FK exclusion can still over-exclude objects sitting IN FRONT of the hand (crops e09a/e02a/e14c); the notes-only sensitivity bounds this.

labels_e1.jsonl is the v1 draft (the colorgate lane treats labels_e1_v2.jsonl as authoritative); this run uses the task-specified v1. Independent verification (LABEL-VERIFY.md): ep0-29 100% accurate in sample; ep30-39 has 10 FP rows + 5 missed objects. Known FPs are annotated and a drop-them sensitivity is reported; the 5 missed visible objects mean even the fair number slightly UNDERSTATES detectable recall.

Note evidence outranks FK/geometry for held/occluded/bin: 'on mat right, occluded by right gripper' is occluded (free object, gripper in front), not in_hand. 'on mat' notes outrank the approximate geom variant but NOT FK occlusion at the centroid. in_hand and occluded are both excluded, so the split never changes the fair recall itself.

Bin-RIM notes ('on left bin rim', 'at right bin rim, being placed') are counted in_bin per the note-mentions-bin rule; the robot path hull-cuts bin regions, so rim objects are not reliably detectable as free mat objects. Rim count is reported separately.
Episodes 40-47 held out: never opened or processed.
